Settings.title: Settings
Settings.body: Here you set how TILL works in this workspace. Pick an area on the left; the search at the top right finds any setting of every area in your own words, from the command search too. A change applies at once, and Undo brings the old value back. Hover a row for Back to the default and Changes: who changed what and when. What the agent may change is chosen under Agent and automation. Protected settings it only proposes, and you approve them.
